stories.title: Solheim Cup Day 2 — Europe Leads 7-5 After Saturday Foursomes at Bernardus Golf

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Europe leads 7-5 at the Solheim Cup.

Maja Stark and Linn Grant beat Nelly Korda and Allisen Corpuz 3&2 in Saturday morning foursomes. Europe won the session 3-1.

Sunday singles — 12 matches, 12 points. Everything still to play for.

#SolheimCup #LPGA

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Europe heads into Sunday singles with a lead at the Solheim Cup at Bernardus Golf.

12 matches on Sunday. Either side needs 14 points total to win.

The final day of the 20th Solheim Cup starts tomorrow.

#SolheimCup #LPGA

article.headline: Europe Leads 7-5 After Saturday Foursomes. Sunday Singles Will Decide the 2026 Solheim Cup.

stories.title: Nelly Korda Benched — Angela Stanford's Bold Saturday Call at Solheim Cup

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Nelly Korda is on the bench for Saturday afternoon fourballs at the Solheim Cup.

World No. 1. Benched.

Captain Angela Stanford rested her after a morning foursomes loss. Korda expected back for Sunday singles.

#SolheimCup #LPGA

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
Alison Lee has gone 3 for 3 at the Solheim Cup this week.

She's been benched for Saturday afternoon fourballs anyway.

Both of USA's most dominant players are resting. Angela Stanford is saving them for Sunday singles.

#SolheimCup #LPGA

article.headline: Angela Stanford Benched Nelly Korda for Saturday Afternoon. It's the Biggest Call of the Solheim Cup.

stories.title: LIV Golf Bankruptcy — CEO Scott O'Neil Targets 2027 Restart, $45M+ Owed to Players

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
LIV Golf CEO Scott O'Neil says the tour plans to restart in early 2027.

Filed Chapter 11 four days ago. $45M+ owed to players. Saudi PIF providing $49.6M in financing to keep it alive.

The plan: restructure, relaunch, survive.

#LIVGolf #Golf

article.headline: LIV Golf CEO Targets 2027 Restart. The Tour Owes Players More Than $45 Million.

stories.title: LIV Players and PGA Tour Future — Koepka's Return Template, Rahm and DeChambeau's Uncertain Path

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Brooks Koepka is back on the PGA Tour after LIV.

The deal: $5M to charity. No equity grants for 5 years. No bonus access in year one.

PGA Tour offered the same terms to Rahm, DeChambeau, and Smith. None accepted. Now LIV is bankrupt.

#Golf #LIVGolf #PGATour

article.headline: Brooks Koepka Is Already Back on the PGA Tour. Rahm, DeChambeau, and Smith Face a Much Less Clear Path.

stories.title: Biltmore Championship Preview — PGA Tour Arrives in Asheville in Five Days

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
Five days until the Biltmore Championship in Asheville.

Jack Nicklaus design. Blue Ridge Mountains. 7,167 yards at 2,100 feet elevation.

First PGA Tour event in western North Carolina since 1942.

Sept 17-20. FedExCup Fall begins.

#PGATour #BiltmoreChampionship

article.headline: The Biltmore Championship Is Five Days Away. Here's What to Know About the PGA Tour's Asheville Debut.
